name: End Of Happiness
source:
It's over, you have failed.

Your timeline, your world is doomed.

Only 8 hours are left before complete ''deletion''.

The only question here is how you will spend your last few hours.

[From [url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/end-of-happiness]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
完了，你失败了。

你的时间线，你的世界就注定了。

距离彻底“删除”仅剩8小时。

这里唯一的问题是你将如何度过最后的几个小时。

[来自[url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/end-of-happiness]Itch.io[/url]]
